label: Cerbo Dyness Balancer
info: TEST_MODE=true. Read-only Dyness RS485 telemetry and shadow controller. DVCC and charger settings are unchanged. State file: /data/home/nodered/cerbo-balancer-state.json.

name: Retain raw CAN frames
Validate RS485 snapshot
Format maintenance telemetry
func:
const s = flow.get('balancerRs485Snapshot') || {}; const n = (v, d = 3) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(d) : '—'; const a = s.aggregate || {}; const sys = s.system || {}; const lim = s.limits || {}; const disc = s.discovery || {}; let out = `## RS485 Dyness telemetry

**Decoder:** ${s.decoderHealth || 'unknown'} | **Valid:** ${s.valid === true ? 'yes' : 'no'} | **Port:** ${s.serialPort || '—'} @ ${s.baud || '—'}

### System and limits

| Value | Reading |
|---|---:|
| System voltage (CID2 61) | ${n(sys.voltage61)} V |
| System SOC (CID2 61) | ${n(sys.soc61, 1)} % |
| Charge voltage limit | ${n(lim.chargeVoltage)} V |
| Discharge voltage limit | ${n(lim.dischargeVoltage)} V |
| CCL | ${n(lim.chargeCurrent, 1)} A |
| DCL signed | ${n(lim.dischargeCurrentSigned, 1)} A |
| Status raw | ${lim.statusRaw == null ? '—' : `0x${Number(lim.statusRaw).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`} |
| Batteries responding | ${disc.respondingCount || 0} (${(disc.respondingAddresses || []).join(', ') || '—'}) |

### Aggregate

Vmin **${n(a.vmin)} V** at battery ${a.minCellAddress ?? '—'} cell ${a.minCellIndex ?? '—'}; Vmax **${n(a.vmax)} V** at battery ${a.maxCellAddress ?? '—'} cell ${a.maxCellIndex ?? '—'}; spread **${n(a.spread * 1000, 1)} mV**; summed current **${n(a.summedBatteryCurrent, 1)} A**; temperature **${n(a.minimumTemperature, 1)}–${n(a.maximumTemperature, 1)} °C**.
`; for (const b of (s.batteries || [])) { out += `
### Battery ${b.address}

Voltage **${n(b.voltage)} V** | Current **${n(b.current, 1)} A** | Δ system **${n(b.systemVoltageDeltaMv, 1)} mV** | valid **${b.valid ? 'yes' : 'no'}**

Cells: ${(b.effective_cells || []).map(cell => `${String(cell.index).padStart(2, '0')}=${n(cell.voltage)} V (${cell.source})`).join(' · ') || '—'}

Temperatures: ${(b.temperatures || []).map((t, i) => `T${i + 1}=${n(t, 1)} °C`).join(' · ') || '—'}

Reported sum **${n(b.directly_reported_cell_sum)} V** | reconstructed sum **${n(b.reconstructed_cell_sum)} V** | Δ **${n(b.reconstructed_voltage_delta_mv, 1)} mV** | errors **${(b.validation_errors || []).join('; ') || 'none'}**
`; } msg.payload = out; return msg;

name: Dyness shadow controller
func: const source = "__CONTROLLER_SOURCE__"; let controller = context.get('controller'); if (!controller) { const module = { exports: {} }; eval(source); controller = module.exports.createBalancerController(); context.set('controller', controller); controller.handle({ type: 'load', timestamp: Date.now() }); } const snapshot = msg.topic === 'rs485' ? msg.payload : flow.get('balancerRs485Snapshot'); let actions; if (msg.topic === 'controller_tick') actions = controller.handle({ type: 'tick', timestamp: Date.now() }); else if (snapshot) { const system = snapshot.system || {}; const limits = snapshot.limits || {}; const aggregate = snapshot.aggregate || {}; actions = controller.handle({ type: 'telemetry', timestamp: Date.now(), telemetry: { ...snapshot, timestamp: snapshot.timestamp, valid: snapshot.valid, cellTelemetryValid: snapshot.cellTelemetryValid, packVoltage: system.voltage61, packCurrent: aggregate.summedBatteryCurrent, soc: system.soc61, vmax: aggregate.vmax, vmin: aggregate.vmin, maxCellIndex: aggregate.maxCellIndex, minCellIndex: aggregate.minCellIndex, ccl: limits.chargeCurrent, dcl: limits.dischargeCurrentSigned, cvl: limits.chargeVoltage, batteries: snapshot.batteries || [] } }); } else return null; const status = actions.find(action => action.type === 'status'); const intent = actions.find(action => action.type === 'voltage_intent'); const persist = actions.find(action => action.type === 'persist'); return [status ? { topic: 'controller_status', payload: status.status } : null, intent ? { topic: 'shadow_command', payload: JSON.stringify(intent) } : null, persist ? { topic: 'controller_state', payload: JSON.stringify(persist) } : null];

name: Format controller status
func: const s = msg.payload || {}; msg.payload = `${s.mode} | ${s.state} | enabled=${s.enabled} | lockout=${s.lockout || 'none'} | Vcmd=${s.packVoltageCommand == null ? '—' : Number(s.packVoltageCommand).toFixed(3)} V`; return msg;
